title: Full Conformance, Golden Cross-System Runtime Proof & Downstream Handoff

selection_basis.strict_order: GPR-01 → GPR-03 → GPR-05 → GPR-06 → GPR-07 → GPR-08 → GPR-09 → GPR-10 → GPR-12 → GPR-16
remaining_golden_dependencies: relevant specialist golden proofs must be resolved before GPR-16 completion
selection_basis.parallel_lanes: MRCS and OARC are terminal completed_verified; GPR is the only nonterminal persistent implementation lane.

objective: Run the complete reduced-family GPR proof: 168-pattern/85-operation/672-variant conformance, the 48-vector PDCP golden acceptance set, original/right-cleared cross-system runtime proof, provider-off/accessibility proof, and reusable downstream handoff without ownership bleed.
acceptance: The complete 168-pattern, 85 primitive-bound operation and 672 failure/partial/cozy/GM variant conformance battery passes without silent unsupported fallback.
All 48 GPR PDCP golden vectors are automated and pass against the published GPR-01 through GPR-12 contracts.

Original/right-cleared traversal/action, puzzle, sports/skill, tactical/strategy, Vehicle, social/investigation and stealth loops are proven without production dependence on protected reference expression.
All seven delivery modes preserve one mechanics/state/Event/outcome model, including direct/cozy parity, governed GM/TTRPG outcomes, embedded minigame, user-authored loop and roster injection.

Rights-safe presentation, multiplayer authority, deterministic replay where declared, snapshot/restore/migration, unsupported-version failure and explainable Event/outcome traces are proven end-to-end.
Provider-off local operation and equivalent nonvisual/keyboard/screen-reader access are blocking-proof requirements.
Relevant specialist golden proofs required by the roadmap are explicitly resolved and attached before GPR-16 can close.
Downstream MERA, MBES, MSLR, MSWI and SMB handoff evidence demonstrates reusable GPR execution/composition without ownership bleed.
boundaries: GPR-16 is proof and handoff, not a new gameplay owner or new content-definition system.
MRCS and specialist creator/domain owners retain canonical definition/content/owner truth.
PCA/Packet-08 retains generic formal-analysis authority; GPR consumes proof/analysis evidence rather than becoming a solver platform.
Protected benchmark expression remains evidence only; golden production fixtures must be original, user-created or rights-cleared.
No optional AI or paid/cloud provider may be required to pass blocking GPR conformance or golden proof.
GPR cannot be marked completed_verified while any required specialist golden dependency is unresolved.
next_action: GPR-16 and the reduced GPR family are completed_verified. MERA-01 has the downstream GPR handoff but is not selected into a persistent implementation lane; replacing a terminal lane requires explicit owner governance.

last_material_progress.evidence: GPR-16 causal RED run 35554748383 failed Linux and Windows focused proof on exact head c5411c14e1c3065af60f228790e2ec1d4b2c4663 because the terminal proof contract was absent; after two verifier-only repairs and one TypeScript inference repair, exact-head GREEN run 35555198316 passed selector/health, Linux, hosted Windows and deterministic comparison on 12b853352ef6171f7ea14297ec1213ef727daa0a; PR 674 published as application main 6e213b66a0a2c03f8c32baba702cb94070a92454.

stop_reason.evidence: GPR-16 terminal conformance/golden proof is durably published, all specialist golden dependencies are resolved, and the GPR family can close completed_verified.

execution_conformance.note: GPR-16 stayed bounded to proof/handoff. Completed specialist families were attached as durable evidence rather than rerun; verifier/type repairs did not weaken proof behavior.

causal_red.head: c5411c14e1c3065af60f228790e2ec1d4b2c4663
causal_red.signature: Both platform focused GPR-16 suites failed because the terminal production proof module did not exist.

terminal_reconciliation.reason: GPR-16 is the terminal GPR golden gate. MERA-01 consumes the handoff, but OPS3 persistent-lane replacement after terminal completion requires explicit owner governance rather than automatic family reassignment.
